description: Convert one file to Markdown, locally on LlmFiles (nothing is kept). Pass the file contents base64-encoded together with its name, or pass a single `uri`: an http(s) link to a public document is fetched once by the server, and a base64 `data:` URI carries the bytes inline. The extension picks the converter, so `report.docx` and `report.pdf` take different paths. HTML pages are stripped of navigation, sidebars and ¶ permalinks by default. Returns the Markdown as text; documents without a text layer (scanned PDF, binary junk) come back as an error with the reason, and no quota is charged.

content_base64.description: The file itself, base64-encoded (a data: URL prefix is accepted).

filename.description: File name with extension, e.g. report.docx or notes.json — the extension decides which converter runs. Required unless `uri` names the document.

strip_nav.description: HTML only: true drops menus, sidebars, footers and ¶ permalinks and keeps article text; false converts the page as it is.

uri.description: Alternative to content_base64: an http(s) URL of a public document (private, local and file:// addresses are refused), or a base64 `data:` URI. The file name comes from the URL or Content-Disposition when `filename` is omitted.

name: convert_file
title: Convert a document to Markdown
